question: Should #95339 continue as the dashboard integration vehicle, or should maintainers pause/close it in favor of the staged modular dashboard path tracked by #101093?
rationale: The PR combines product direction, security-boundary changes, workflow automation changes, release-file drift, and stale proof; automation cannot choose the intended dashboard architecture or security posture.

options.title: Pause and use staged dashboard review
options.body: Treat #101093 and its staged PRs as the canonical direction, preserving any useful pieces from #95339 only after owner review.

options.title: Repair this PR in place
options.body: Require the contributor to rebase, restore release-owned files, fix protocol schemas, provide current-head proof, and get owner approval for security/workflow surfaces.

options.title: Close or defer dashboard expansion
options.body: Decline this broad dashboard direction for now and ask for narrower future issues only after the product/security model is settled.

recommendation.title: Pause and use staged dashboard review
recommendation.body: Treat #101093 and its staged PRs as the canonical direction, preserving any useful pieces from #95339 only after owner review.

likelyOwner.reason: The open questions span Control UI direction, gateway protocol, release process, and security-sensitive proof/approval behavior where available history points to Peter as the best routing owner.
